result.summary: The home feed looks mostly complete, but the selected tab does not match the screen, and the Fastest near you row clips a restaurant name at the screen edge.

issues.description: Bottom navigation highlights Profile (green) while the visible screen is the Home/delivery feed.
issues.suggestion: Keep the Home tab selected on this screen and only highlight Profile on the profile view.

issues.description: The third Fastest near you card is clipped, and the name reads as “Trattoria Piccol” with no ellipsis.
issues.suggestion: Give the peeking card a consistent inset, and truncate overflowing titles with an ellipsis so names do not cut mid-word.

issues.description: Category chips run off the right edge (Healthy and the next pill are partially cut).
issues.suggestion: If this is a horizontal scroller, add end padding or a fade so the cut-off does not look accidental.
